dominance_notes.method: Reconciled 736 images + 77 pages + counts.json + 8 Nova prompts + photography-direction + voice-tone + 9 briefs. Filenames quantified (waffle 80, oat 77, pancake 47, protein 43); page text concordance (keep it wild 310, whole grain 286, protein 5035, frontier 81/561, wild 819). Brown kraft/bear is infrastructural packshot (header texture + logo) rather than keyword literal, so ranked #1 by packaging frequency + design-token binding.
dominance_notes.remove_bus_noise: Discard 7-Eleven/Giorgio/Escort artifacts — not in Kodiak corpus (separate brand-lore) — keep only Wasatch/Park City/Vital Ground bear-human coexistence narrative (photography-direction grizzly_safe).
dominance_notes.compliance: All nutrition claims gated via compliance.py prohibited_terms + logo_overlay true + palette probe (Bear Brown sampled from hero when possible). 14g not 17%.
